name: Call of Duty 4 (CoD4x)
author: barticekk@barticekk.eu
description:
CoD4x is the maintained server for Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare. It fixes the original server's
bugs and adds plugins, a new master server and automatic client updates. The original game files
(main/*.iwd and zone/) have to be uploaded from your own copy of the game.
startup: ./cod4x18_dedrun +set dedicated 2 +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +set fs_basepath /home/container +set fs_homepath /home/container +set sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +set sv_authtoken "{{AUTH_TOKEN}}" $( [ -n "{{FS_GAME}}" ] && printf %s "+set fs_game {{FS_GAME}}" ) +exec {{SERVER_CONFIG}} +map_rotate

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CoD4x install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -e
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates unzip

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p main zone mods usermaps plugins

if [ -z "${COD4X_VERSION}" ] || [ "${COD4X_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    BASE=https://github.com/callofduty4x/CoD4x_Server/releases/latest/download
else
    BASE=https://github.com/callofduty4x/CoD4x_Server/releases/download/${COD4X_VERSION}
fi

echo "Downloading CoD4x server from ${BASE}"
curl -fsSL -o cod4x18_dedrun "${BASE}/cod4x18_dedrun"
chmod 755 cod4x18_dedrun

if curl -fsSL -o /tmp/plugins.zip "${BASE}/plugins_linux.zip"; then
    unzip -oqj /tmp/plugins.zip -d plugins
    rm -f /tmp/plugins.zip
fi

if [ ! -f "main/${SERVER_CONFIG}" ]; then
    cat > "main/${SERVER_CONFIG}" <<'EOF'
// CoD4x server config, executed on start
set sv_hostname "^2Pelican ^7CoD4x Server"
set g_motd "Have fun"
set rcon_password ""
set g_password ""
set sv_privateClients 0
set sv_privatePassword ""

set sv_pure 1
set sv_floodprotect 1
set sv_maxPing 0
set sv_minPing 0
set sv_timeout 40
set sv_allowDownload 1
set sv_wwwDownload 0
set sv_wwwBaseURL ""

set g_gametype "war"
set scr_war_scorelimit 7500
set scr_war_timelimit 15
set scr_teambalance 1
set scr_game_spectatetype 1

set sv_mapRotation "gametype war map mp_crash gametype war map mp_backlot gametype war map mp_strike gametype war map mp_crossfire gametype war map mp_vacant gametype war map mp_overgrown gametype war map mp_citystreets gametype war map mp_bloc"
EOF
    if [ -n "${RCON_PASSWORD}" ]; then
        sed -i "s#^set rcon_password \"\"#set rcon_password \"${RCON_PASSWORD}\"#" "main/${SERVER_CONFIG}"
    fi
fi

if ! ls main/iw_*.iwd > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "================================================================"
    echo " Upload the original game files before starting the server:"
    echo "   <CoD4 folder>/main/*.iwd  ->  main/"
    echo "   <CoD4 folder>/zone/*      ->  zone/"
    echo "================================================================"
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "CoD4x installed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Config
variables.description: Config file in main/ executed on start.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Written into the config on the first install; change it there afterwards.

variables.name: Auth Token
variables.description: Server token from the CoD4x master server (cod4x.ovh), needed to be listed publicly.

variables.name: Mod (fs_game)
variables.description: Optional mod folder, e.g. mods/promod. Leave empty for the stock game.

variables.name: CoD4x Version
variables.description: latest or a release tag such as 21.2. Reinstall to update.
